items.text: Final report: New England ruled out G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring), G Ben Brown (knee), CB Carlton Davis III (neck), CB Karon Prunty (hamstring) and CB Channing Canada (hamstring). RT Morgan Moses (foot), S Kevin Byard III (chest), S Craig Woodson (shoulder) and LB Christian Elliss (chest) are questionable. Drake Maye is not on the report.

Final report: Chicago ruled out RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) and LB Jack Sanborn (concussion); LB T.J. Edwards (hamstring) is doubtful and CB Tyrique Stevenson (hip) questionable. Caleb Williams is not on the report.
New England WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is on IR.
